hero.description: Hi, I'm Donya Mardani — a software engineer specializing in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I build web applications with clean, maintainable, and high-performance code.

about.p1: I'm a passionate software engineer with over 2 years of experience building digital products that aim to make a real impact. My journey started with curiosity about how the web works and grew into a focus on modern front-end technologies.
about.p2: I specialize in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, building everything from sleek landing pages to complex enterprise applications. My approach pairs technical excellence with a close attention to design and user experience.
about.quote: "My mission is to create digital experiences that aren't just functional, but genuinely enjoyable — products people love to use, and code developers love to maintain."
